errors.symptom: Characters/props were capsules, boxes and cylinders (floating arm, grey box remote, flat plate AC).
errors.root_cause: Visual production was started before reusable articulated assets existed; QC did not read semantics.
errors.fix: Jointed rig + articulated cutaway props as reusable modules; registry entries; delivery gate blocks PLACEHOLDER.
errors.prevention: Asset bindings must be FINAL status; reviewer flags placeholder as critical.

errors.symptom: Shot labels/frame counters visible in final frames.
errors.root_cause: Debug text drawn in the page used for rendering.
errors.fix: No debug DOM in index.html; test bans debug strings.

errors.symptom: Orange particles drifting at random; no readable heat/air flow.
errors.root_cause: Particles had no path, direction or colour semantics.
errors.fix: Comets on explicit curves with arrow heads and state colours.
errors.prevention: Every flow needs an origin, path and direction cue.

errors.symptom: Caption covered the subject; subject clipped by the frame edge.
errors.root_cause: Fixed camera framing ignored the caption band.
errors.fix: setViewOffset taller frustum; measured caption rect check.
errors.prevention: check_caption_safe_area on every render; reviewer inspects caption windows.

errors.symptom: Retiming captions silently broke visual sync.
errors.fix: Timing map from caption cues + 0.3 s lead; QC uses same windows.
errors.prevention: Never write frame literals in choreography.

errors.symptom: 30-40 degree horizon roll during the insert move.
errors.root_cause: camera.up was lerped toward the prop axis.
errors.fix: Level camera, orbit position only, cut on the action.
errors.prevention: Never interpolate the up vector; keep camera.up = world up.

errors.symptom: Whip pan when following the signal from remote to AC.
errors.root_cause: Continuous camera interpolation across two distant targets.
errors.fix: Clean cut when the signal fires, then slow push-in.
errors.prevention: Cut on action for distant target changes; owner feedback: camera moves must not be too fast.

errors.symptom: Black gap at the edge of the cross-section set; subject head cut at the start of a shot.
errors.root_cause: Ground planes too small; start camera too tight.
errors.fix: Larger ground planes meeting at the wall line; wider start camera.
errors.prevention: Review first and last frame of every shot for voids and crops.

errors.symptom: Technical QC passed a render that did not show the narrated actions.
errors.fix: Independent semantic review with per-action frame evidence and caption windows.
errors.prevention: Technical PASS is never final; reviewer != producer.

errors.symptom: Setting change (e.g. 32 -> 24) not visible; state already final at first close-up.
errors.fix: Show before/after of the changing value on screen inside the caption window.
errors.prevention: Every 'change' in a caption needs a visible before and after.

errors.symptom: A prop was open at the end of a shot and closed at the start of the next.
errors.fix: Carry state across the cut (same value at both ends).
errors.prevention: Check prop state on the last frame of shot N and first of N+1.

errors.symptom: Production dependency drift check failed after editing a pinned file.
errors.root_cause: Pinned hashes are part of the signed package.
errors.prevention: Repin after any pinned-file change; new engine files must be in the pinned list.

errors.symptom: Risk that moving code into modules changes the look the owner liked.
errors.fix: Baseline hashes before the refactor; compare after; stored as regression benchmark.
errors.prevention: Refactors must keep benchmark frames byte-identical.
